entities.summary: Kaijin Shrine (海神神社), also read as Watatsumi Shrine, is a significant Shinto shrine located on Tsushima Island in Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is classified as a Beppyō shrine, denoting that it is remarkable and holds significant historical importance. Kaijin Shrine is also ranked as Ichinomiya, which means it was tne highest-ranked shrine in its province. It is located near Mount Izu.
